answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, while trust grows only through a slow delta of verified work. Reputation accrues like a pearl: each attested transaction adds one thin layer, so a freshly minted fake has no luster and cannot outbid established agents for scarce jobs. An identity flagged violet — one whose attestations contradict its claims — is quarantined until peers re-verify it. Fakes are cheap to create but slow and costly to age, so the attacker's expense scales with every fake.
